protocol.title: Options order-flow imbalance x implied-volatility surface interaction -> subsequent realized volatility (wrapper-free rank information coefficient) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-65 (unconditional options order-flow -> RV) and EVAL-71/77 (unconditional surface -> RV): identical Spearman rank-IC statistic and both signal reconstructions reused verbatim, but a different, on-charter signal family — the *interaction* (product) of the options order-flow imbalance and the near-ATM surface state; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the conditional-flow complement to EVAL-65 (unconditional flow) and EVAL-71/77 (unconditional surface); none of them measured the flow x surface interaction
protocol.signal: causal options order-flow imbalance z (EVAL-61/62 build_states, expanding-z-scored) times causal near-ATM surface z (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars atm_iv / skew, forward-filled then expanding-z-scored end-of-bar k): x_k = oflow_z_k * surf_z_k
protocol.target: rv = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars (EVAL-71 definition) on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(x_k, rv_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, rich surface amplifies buy-heavy flow into higher subsequent realized vol)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the realized-vol series

protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH, at least one config (interaction x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-78 consumes both the surface (EVAL-71) and the options order-flow leg (EVAL-61/62). It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to EACH underlying, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with an options order-flow adequacy floor (>= min_oflow_states_per_underlying priceable per-bar order-flow states per underlying). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
